name: 86 Chaos 17.1.11
label: 86 Chaos 17.1.11
notes: Activates the mobile Voice control on touch/pen pointer-down, before the global mobile touchend guard can cancel the synthesized click.
Deduplicates the follow-up compatibility click so one physical tap starts exactly one 86Voice session.
Blocks context-menu, drag, touch callout, and text selection behavior on the Voice control so the browser cannot turn the microphone gesture into a page/link address copy action.
Routes the toolbar through the same openAndListen controller used by the restored production 17.0.29 SpeechRecognition lifecycle.
title: 86 Chaos 17.1.11
summary: Makes the mobile 86Voice toolbar react to the physical touch/pen press before mobile touchend cancellation and blocks browser URL-copy callouts.
description: Preserves the production 17.0.29 Web Speech lifecycle and Concept 1 UI while repairing the mobile toolbar event path that could lose the synthesized click or trigger a browser copy-address callout.
highlights: Mobile Voice uses the physical touch event instead of depending only on onClick.
The browser copy-address/context-callout path is suppressed only on the Voice button.
Desktop voice behavior and the new six-button Concept 1 toolbar layout are unchanged.
The 17.0.29 SpeechRecognition/webkitSpeechRecognition lifecycle remains the microphone engine.
